title: Component behavior contract
description: Layer 1 structural schema for a platform-agnostic behavior contract, `behaviors/<component>.json` (spec/behavior-contract.md, proposal 022). Semantic rules (options, facets, parts, intents and capabilities resolve) are Layer 2 (SPEC-118..120).

component.description: Name of the component declaration this contract describes.

extends.description: Shared base contracts: names of pattern files in `behaviors/patterns/` (for example `interactive`, which publishes the interaction facets).

state.description: Option ids of the component this contract owns. The option stays the source; the contract does not redeclare it.

facets.description: What the appearance layer may read, each derived from state, keyed by facet id (registry/facets.json).

parts.description: Per anatomy part: role, focus model and press behavior. Keys are anatomy part names.

transitions.description: What each intent does to state: a guarded table, never a DOM event.

semantics.description: Per anatomy part, facet id to the accessibility state it exposes.

vectors.description: Conformance vectors: start state, intents, expected facets and events.

pins.description: Conformance suites only. What the suite holds true of the contract regardless of its vectors: the `state` list, the contract's `wcag` and each part's `role`, `focus`, `press` and `handles`. The runner fails a contract that differs.

needs.description: Capabilities (registry/capabilities.json) the platform must have for this to apply.

wcag.description: Applicable WCAG 2.x success criteria, for the contract, a facet or a part.

from.description: The option id, or ids, the facet derives from.

additionalProperties.description: Single source option: the option value that selects the facet value. Several: an object of option values that must all match.

values.description: Facet value id to the option value (one source) or option-to-value match (several sources) that selects it.

focus.description: tab-stop: in the tab order. roving: one peer is the tab stop at a time. none: not focusable.

handles.description: Intents the part handles that change no state (for example `navigate-items`, `increment`). Intents that change state are `transitions`.

facetRef.description: The value of a facet of the group contract, read when the intent runs.

slot.description: The slot of the component whose fills are the group's items.

item.description: The item's contract: the name of a component with a contract (an `accepts` slot), or an inline contract body (a `collection: items` slot, whose items are entries of an array option).

mode.description: `none`: choosing does nothing. `single`: choosing turns the item on and the others off. `multiple`: choosing toggles the item. A facet reference names a group facet whose values are these.

allowsEmpty.description: Whether the group may have no item on. When false, choosing never turns the last item off. A facet reference names a group facet with values `true` and `false`.

choose.description: What the `choose` action (`do.choose`) does in this group. The group's value is derived from its items, never stored.

wrap.description: `navigate-next` on the last item goes to the first, and `navigate-previous` on the first to the last.

skip.description: A guard over the item's facets: an item it holds for is passed over (for example `disabled` is `true`).

first.description: `navigate-first` moves to the first item that is not skipped.

last.description: `navigate-last` moves to the last item that is not skipped.

selectOnMove.description: Moving onto an item fires the item's `press` intent, so selection follows focus.

mirror.description: A guard over the group's facets: while it holds, the runner swaps ArrowLeft and ArrowRight before it looks the key up in the bindings.

focus.description: Overrides the focus model of the item's part, when the group sets one. Metadata only; the runner does not model focus.

traversal.description: How `navigate-*` intents on the group move a logical focus over its items, by index.

collection.description: A group of items (a group is a collection, proposal 022 question 5). The group contract carries the traversal and choosing rules; the item contract keeps what one item does.

choose.description: An item option the enclosing group's `collection.choose` decides (single: on, others off; multiple: toggle; never the last off unless `allowsEmpty`). The group raises one event with the indices that are on. Outside a group it toggles the option.

raise.description: After the transition, fire the `press` intent of the first part that declares one (`press-end` in the interactive pattern).

via.description: The event's `via` this transition applies to (for example `keyboard` on `focus`). Absent: any.

map.description: The key is a facet id: facet value to the attribute's value.

copy.description: The key is an option id (listed in `state`): the attribute is the option's value as given, and absent while the option is unset.

absentWhen.description: With `copy`: the attribute is absent while every listed option has the listed value (an indeterminate progress bar has no value).

emitOptions.description: How an expected `emit` event is compared: `exact` (default) needs the same options and values; `listed` checks only the options the expectation lists. For a role key vector that runs on components that differ.

items.description: A group contract: one option set per item, run as the item contract.

focused.description: A group contract: the index of the item the logical focus starts on (default 0).

start.description: Start values of options, plus environment properties such as `direction` (`ltr`, `rtl`).

item.description: A group contract: run the intent on this item (by index) instead of on the group.

input.description: A key press phase, resolved to intents through the platform's bindings for the role of the contract's role-carrying part. A key with no binding raises nothing.

items.description: A group contract: per item, the facet values it must have after the step; `null` is an item not checked.

focused.description: A group contract: the index the logical focus is on after the step.

aria.description: Accessibility attributes the contract's `semantics` expose after the step: attribute name to its value, or `null` when it is absent.
